listing.name: Project Gotham Racing 3 — PGR3-recomp (jpneagle)
listing.summary: Only a small section has been checked using scripted input and frame/audio captures. Expect bugs. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use only your own Japan/Asia Xbox 360 Project Gotham Racing 3 release (En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Zh,Ko), title 4D5307D1, with default.xex built 2005-10-30T23:26:30Z. Supply an XGD2 ISO or all extracted game files. North American and European releases are untested and expected to be incompatible. The bundled GeometryWars gw.xex is unsupported.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use Windows source build then play.bat configuration/launch with own supported PGR3 XGD2 disc.

warnings: Only a small section has been checked using scripted input and frame/audio captures. Expect bugs.
